articles.standfirst: The Chiefs may not rush Kenneth Walker III back, and rookie Emmett Johnson is giving Kansas City a major reason to wait.
articles.summary: The Chiefs may not rush Kenneth Walker III back, and rookie Emmett Johnson is giving Kansas City a major reason to wait.
articles.body:
K ansas City Chiefs can feel like they are trending in the right direction after back-to-back wins over the New York Jets and Atlanta Falcons , but they could face the Arizona Cardinals without a key piece of their offense.

Andy Reid ’s team will look to secure its third straight victory in Week 11 , although the physical toll from the Atlanta matchup raised some concerns. One of the biggest question marks is the status of running back Kenneth Walker III , who could miss a second consecutive game — a situation that may cause concern within the organization.

There is no need to rush Kenneth Walker III back

According to Adam Schefter during his appearance on The Pat McAfee Show , the Chiefs are considering holding Walker out for another week after he suffered a groin injury during practice before the matchup against the Falcons.

“They (the Chiefs) said that the idea was to shut him (Walker) down for a week,” Schefter stated.

Although there was initially optimism that Walker would return against Arizona, the ESPN NFL insider explained that Kansas City does not want to take unnecessary risks with the running back, especially with another reliable option emerging in the offense.

“I think they believe it’s a short-term injury. That’s the hope and belief right now. But I will also say that Kenneth Walker has had some soft tissue injuries before that have gone beyond a week. You bring him back when he’s ready. If that’s this week, great, but there’s not really a rush to bring him back when Emmett Johnson is playing the way he is. Would it surprise me if it went beyond this week? No.”

The impressive performance of rookie Emmett Johnson has given Kansas City the flexibility to be patient with Walker’s recovery.

Johnson stepped into the starting role against Atlanta and delivered a standout performance, recording 171 total yards and two touchdowns , proving he can handle the workload while Walker works his way back.

With Johnson playing at a high level, the Chiefs have little reason to risk rushing Walker back against the Cardinals. Giving him an additional week to recover could also help him return in better shape for Kansas City’s highly anticipated Thanksgiving showdown against the Buffalo Bills , one of the most important games remaining on their schedule.

articles.title: Tyreek Hill hasn't given up on returning to the Chiefs and is spending his money on the doctor who helped Christian McCaffrey and Usain Bolt
articles.standfirst: The former Miami Dolphins receiver has travelled to Germany for specialist knee treatment as he continues working towards an NFL comeback
articles.summary: The former Miami Dolphins receiver has travelled to Germany for specialist knee treatment as he continues working towards an NFL comeback
articles.body:
Tyreek Hill is taking another step towards an NFL comeback, travelling to Germany for treatment from a physician whose patients have included Olympic champion Usain Bolt and San Francisco 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey as the visit has renewed attention on his recovery and a possible return to the Kansas City Chiefs . Hill ’s rehabilitation follows a brutal injury against the New York Jets on September 29, 2025 as he dislocated his left knee and suffered multiple ligament injuries, including an ACL tear, before undergoing two operations. The Miami Dolphins released him in February 2026 after he failed a physical.

And the 32-year-old visited Dr. Hans-Wilhelm Muller-Wohlfahrt in Munich and shared footage of the specialist examining his injured knee, a physician connected to soccer who also recently examined the New England Patriots ’ A. J. Brown . “Went overseas to work with the Doc who’s helped some of the GOATs. The comeback continues,” Hill wrote, signaling his determination to get back on the field. Muller-Wohlfahrt spent more than 40 years working with Bayern Munich and served Germany ’s national soccer team from 1995 to 2018. He also treated Bolt ahead of the 2016 Rio Olympics , where the Jamaican sprinter won three gold medals, adding to the physician’s reputation in elite sport. Muller-Wohlfahrt also helped McCaffrey recover from his own devastating injuries to great success, with the 30-year-old veteran recently producing 62 rushing yards and 161 receiving yards against the Dallas Cowboys on November 15, whilst also scoring three touchdowns.

Chiefs reunion remains in play as Josh Downs impresses

Now Hill ’s agent, Drew Rosenhaus , said on The Pat McAfee Show on November 10 that he was approaching a possible return with the likes of the 49ers , Los Angeles Rams and Chiefs reported to be in the mix to sign the Super Bowl winner and stellar wide receiver. Kansas City has reportedly contacted Hill ’s representatives about a reunion with the receiver who spent his first six NFL seasons with the franchise and won Super Bowl LIV alongside Patrick Mahomes - yet the Chiefs have since strengthened their options, acquiring Josh Downs from the Indianapolis Colts on November 10. Downs made an immediate impression in his debut against the Atlanta Falcons on November 15, catching five passes for 53 yards and an 18-yard touchdown in Kansas City’s 35-13 victory despite having only two days of practice and 10 offensive snaps. Still, he made his opportunities count. Three of Downs ’ five targets produced first downs, whilst Pro Football Focus awarded him a 91.3 receiving grade, the highest by a Chiefs receiver since Hill posted the same mark in 2021 as Rashee Rice added 82 yards, and rookies Cyrus Allen and Andrew Armstrong also scored. Downs offers reliable route-running and the ability to move the chains, whereas Hill ’s greatest weapon has been his game-changing speed and deep-threat ability and whilst Kansas City could still benefit from that dimension, they are now no longer under pressure to sign Cheetah . Hill ’s knee must withstand NFL demands before any deal becomes realistic and his recovery remains uncertain, but it does not close the door on a reunion as the treatment in Munich is part of his comeback effort.

articles.title: The wife of a player released by the Chiefs reveals the cold text message her husband received informing him of his release
articles.standfirst: Nikko Remigio’s release from the Kansas City Chiefs came without warning to his family. His wife recounted how her husband found out he would not be continuing with Kansas City and shared the content of the message he received.
articles.summary: Nikko Remigio’s release from the Kansas City Chiefs came without warning to his family. His wife recounted how her husband found out he would not be continuing with Kansas City and shared the content of the message he received.
articles.body:
Maureen Remigio, wife of returner Nikko Remigio , revealed how her husband found out that the Kansas City Chiefs had cut him: via text message. “We got a text saying he had to show up, bring his iPad, and that’s it,” she recounted in a video posted on Instagram.

The Chiefs released him on Wednesday, November 11, to make room on the roste r for newly acquired wide receiver Josh Downs. Nikko had been with the team for four seasons and had been the starting punt returner for the past three. On Thursday, November 12, Houston claimed him , and by Sunday he had already made his debut with the Texans.

A 24-hour wait without knowing his fate

Maureen explained the process that kicks in when a player is cut. “Within 24 hours, any team can claim you and continue your contract. During that time, you don’t know where you’re going or who’s going to want you,” she said. According to her account, the couple spent that day pacing around the house waiting for a call.

The answer came just as the deadline was about to expire. “Right around the 24-hour mark, we found out that the Texans had claimed Nikko,” she said. Houston gave him two and a half hours to catch a flight from Kansas City, and the couple lives 45 minutes from the airport. “And guess what? We threw some clothes in our suitcases and I rushed him there. And just like that, suddenly, he’s in Houston,” she recounted.

She stayed in Kansas City with a to-do list: what to do about the house, the pets, and which area of Houston to look for a place to live. She turned to friends and other players’ wives who had already been through the same thing. She didn’t want to burden her husband with those decisions, she explained: “These are things you don’t put on your partner, because he already has a lot on his plate.”

Maureen also spoke about the nature of the business. “It’s a very cold business at times. One day you have a job, and the next you might not,” she said. She recalled that Nikko arrived as an undrafted free agent, so he always had to fight for his spot. Regarding the move, she was optimistic because Houston has a large Filipino and Asian community.

The departure also drew reactions within the club. Dave Toub, the Chiefs’ special teams coordinator, said it was “a tearful farewell” and that Nikko “is like a son.” He described him as “honest and reliable.” The player, for his part, said goodbye on Instagram: “The love this community showed my wife and me will never be forgotten. I promise you that I gave it my all every time my cleats touched the field.”

Maureen, a former track athlete for the Philippine national team, met Nikko through a mutual speed coach in California. They got married this summer. In Kansas City, she gained followers with cooking videos for her husband and published an e-book of Filipino-Chinese comfort food recipes. In her farewell post, she wrote: “Thank you for loving this Filipina.”

Nikko has already made his debut with the Texans , while Maureen remains in Kansas City sorting out the move.

articles.title: Andy Reid confirms that the Chiefs' star “may” not play again this week
articles.standfirst: Josh Simmons is eligible to begin his return from injured reserve, but there is little sign of encouragement
articles.summary: Josh Simmons is eligible to begin his return from injured reserve, but there is little sign of encouragement
articles.body:
A ndy Reid ’s latest comments have left the Kansas City Chiefs facing an uncomfortable question about Josh Simmons as although eligible to begin his return from injured reserve, the young tackle appears no closer to a comeback and fans wonder will their first-round left tackle play again this season? Simmons became eligible after the Chiefs beat the Atlanta Falcons on Sunday, completing the minimum four-week absence required after his Week 7 placement on injured reserve, meaning Kansas City can now open a 21-day practice window or leave him on the reserve list for the rest of the campaign.

However, Reid said Monday that he had not discussed the decision with head trainer Rick Burkholder or general manager Brett Veach and whilst he stopped short of ruling out a return, he hinted the Chiefs were unlikely to open the window immediately, leaving Simmons ’ status unresolved. “I haven’t visited with Rick or Veach on that,” Reid said after the Chiefs improved to 7-2 in Atlanta . “So I’m not going to answer. I don’t presume that’s going to happen, but I haven’t visited with those guys before I say that.” The comments offer little encouragement for an imminent return at this stage as Simmons has not practiced since August 18 at training camp and was diagnosed with a bulging disc and only appeared in eight games as a rookie, with injuries and personal matters limiting his availability.

Chiefs fans begin to grow frustrated with Simmons’ injury history

Drafted to protect Patrick Mahomes ’ blind side for years, Simmons has instead become a source of frustration among some supporters, and that scrutiny intensified after reports of a heated exchange involving the tackle, Reid and the quarterback during a team meeting. Adding another complication to his difficult start in Kansas City , Simmons was reportedly sitting with his feet elevated because of back and hip discomfort when Reid asked him to put them down. Mahomes backed his coach and told him to leave the meeting. The player later apologized to Reid and the team’s leadership for how he handled the disagreement but the incident has done little to calm fans who question his commitment, while online conspiracies claiming has suggested he could be exaggerating his injury to avoid playing. There is no substantiated evidence for that allegation and the official explanation remains that Simmons is injured and undergoing rehabilitation as Burkholder has said the 23-year-old has worked diligently with the medical staff but reached a plateau in his recovery. Additionally, the former Chiefs All-Pro lineman Mitchell Schwartz has also disputed suggestions that the tackle disappeared, saying he continued attending meetings and rehabilitating at the facility. One thing that is clear though, is that Kansas City could use the help. Undrafted rookie Kahlil Benson has started every game at tackle and is beginning to struggle at left tackle, a position he never played in college whilst guard Trey Smith also left Sunday’s game with a concussion and Creed Humphrey briefly missed a snap after an eye injury. Making matters worse, right tackle Jaylon Moore was unavailable against the Falcons while recovering from an ankle injury and although Mahomes stunned with five touchdowns and 348 yards, the Chiefs cannot rely on magic from their two-time MVP and three-time champion on every play.

articles.title: Not everything is going well for the Chiefs: Xavier Worthy makes a painful decision after the game against the Falcons
articles.standfirst: Chiefs star faces growing pressure as new teammates steal the spotlight
articles.summary: Chiefs star faces growing pressure as new teammates steal the spotlight
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs had plenty of reasons to celebrate their convincing 35-13 victory over the Atlanta Falcons , but the afternoon wasn't particularly enjoyable for everyone.

Wide receiver Xavier Worthy endured a disappointing performance, and his apparent decision to deactivate his Instagram account after the game has sparked concern among supporters.

The 23-year-old entered the NFL with enormous expectations after the Chiefs selected him in the first round of the 2024 NFL Draft. His incredible 4.21-second 40-yard dash at the NFL Scouting Combine made headlines and raised hopes that he could become one of Patrick Mahomes' most dangerous offensive weapons.

However, Worthy's latest performance highlighted some of the difficulties he's experienced in establishing himself as a consistent receiver.

Against Atlanta, he finished without a single reception despite receiving three targets. What's particularly concerning is that he played 56 offensive snaps, giving him more opportunities than several teammates who managed to make a significant impact.

Mahomes threw for 348 yards and five touchdowns, with several less-established players benefiting from his outstanding performance. Cyrus Allen and Andrew Armstron g both recorded touchdown catches, while recently acquired Josh Downs also found the end zone. Rashee Rice contributed five receptions for 82 yards.

Worthy , meanwhile, struggled to make his presence felt. He also experienced an unfortunate moment on an onside kick, appearing to misjudge the ball before the Falcons recovered it.

Following the game, a fan account on X highlighted that Worthy had deactivated his Instagram account. His official profile appeared unavailable, although the reason behind his decision remains unknown.

Andy Reid supports Xavier Worthy despite growing competition

Worthy's disappointing afternoon comes amid questions about his overall development. Following a promising rookie season featuring 59 receptions for 638 yards and six touchdowns, his production dropped to 42 catches, 532 yards and one touchdown the following year.

His current campaign has also raised concerns about whether he's developing quickly enough to meet expectations.

Nevertheless, head coach Andy Reid has publicly backed the young receiver, insisting that his lack of production doesn't necessarily reflect his importance to the offense.

“He just needs to keep doing his thing and working, and he’ll be fine,” Reid said. “Some days will be his, and some days it goes to other guys. I mean, that’s just how this thing works. We’re spreading it around. Pat (Patrick Mahomes) loves spreading it around and does a great job with it.

Mahomes offered a similar explanation, pointing out that Worthy's route helped draw two defenders away from Josh Downs on his touchdown reception.

However, the arrival of Downs could make Worthy's situation increasingly complicated. The former Indianapolis Colts receiver impressed in his Kansas City debut, recording four catches for 53 yards and a touchdown despite running only eight routes.

ESPN analyst Ben Solak believes Downs could become a crucial contributor as the Chiefs pursue another Super Bowl appearance.

With Downs and Rice potentially establishing themselves as Mahomes ' leading receiving options, Worthy could face reduced responsibilities. Cyrus Allen is also pushing for additional opportunities.

The Chiefs still believe Worthy can contribute, but he'll need to demonstrate greater consistency. His speed remains an enormous asset, yet turning that athletic ability into reliable production will be essential if he wants to remain a key piece in Kansas City's plans.

articles.title: Chiefs make drastic decision and terminate two WR contracts after Patrick Mahomes’ performance
articles.standfirst: Kansas City is making moves behind the scenes after sending a strong message to the rest of the NFL
articles.summary: Kansas City is making moves behind the scenes after sending a strong message to the rest of the NFL
articles.body:
T he Chiefs delivered one of their most convincing performances of the 2026 season , defeating the Atlanta Falcons 35-13 on the road. Patrick Mahomes led the offense with 348 passing yards and five touchdowns, finishing the game without throwing an interception. It was also his first performance with at least four passing touchdowns in nearly a year.

Chiefs make changes to their practice squad

Mahomes also had a new weapon to work with after Kansas City acquired wide receiver Josh Downs from the Indianapolis Colts ahead of the trade deadline. The receiver made an immediate impact in his debut, recording four receptions for 53 yards and a touchdown, including an 18-yard scoring connection with Mahomes just before halftime.

Following that performance, the Chiefs decided to make adjustments to their roster. According to Athlon Sports , Kansas City terminated the practice squad contracts of wide receivers Jacob De Jesus and Bub Means on Tuesday, November 17.

Two receivers leave as Kansas City adds new players

The moves opened two spots on the practice squad, which were filled by tight end John FitzPatrick and running back E.J. Smith. The changes were also reported by Charles Goldman of A to Z Sports.

De Jesus had recently been elevated for the Chiefs' Week 10 matchup against Atlanta. He originally joined Kansas City as an undrafted free agent in 2026 after playing college football at California. Although the team released him during its final roster cuts in August, he returned to the practice squad on November 4. Means, meanwhile, joined Kansas City on the same date after being released by the Cleveland Browns. The 2024 fifth-round pick of the New Orleans Saints previously recorded nine receptions for 118 yards and a touchdown during his rookie season, but he never appeared in a regular-season game for the Chiefs. The roster adjustments come with Kansas City holding a 7-2 record and preparing for its next challenge against the Arizona Cardinals in Week 11 . articles.standfirst: Kansas City's resurgence has Russell Wilson making a bold playoff prediction that will excite Chiefs fans and worry the rest of the AFC.
articles.summary: Kansas City's resurgence has Russell Wilson making a bold playoff prediction that will excite Chiefs fans and worry the rest of the AFC.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs once again look like one of the most dangerous teams in the NFL . After an unexpected midseason slump, Andy Reid ’s squad responded with two dominant wins in Weeks 9 and 10, regaining momentum just as the race for the AFC’s top seed intensifies.

While the victory over the Atlanta Falcons did not come against an elite opponent, it delivered an important takeaway: Kansas City’s passing attack has rediscovered its explosiveness. The addition of Josh Downs before the trade deadline has revitalized the offense and once again turned the Chiefs into a nightmare for opposing defenses.

Sitting at 7-2 , Kansas City remains in pursuit of the Buffalo Bills (8-1) in the battle for the AFC’s No. 1 seed . Plenty of football remains, but for Super Bowl-winning quarterback Russell Wilson, the outcome appears clear.

Russell Wilson sees the Chiefs as the AFC’s best team

Heading into the 2026 season, serious questions surrounded Kansas City’s offensive potential. The biggest uncertainty centered on Patrick Mahomes , who was returning from a torn ACL and LCL suffered at the end of the previous campaign. Even if the quarterback regained his form, doubts lingered about whether he would have enough weapons to dominate the league again.

The Chiefs, however, found a new formula for winning. The offensive focal point shifted to running back Kenneth Walker III , who became the centerpiece of the attack. But when Walker was sidelined against Atlanta with a groin injury, Mahomes reminded the rest of the NFL why he remains one of the planet’s elite quarterbacks by throwing five touchdown passes.

With a defense that continues to rank among the league’s strongest, the Chiefs have reclaimed the identity that turned them into a dynasty under Andy Reid . While some point to the pressure applied by the Denver Broncos in the AFC West, Wilson has no doubt about who will ultimately control the conference.

“I think they’re going to be the best team in the AFC. I think they end up in the No. 1 seed in the AFC,” Wilson said on Set Hut!. “The DNA of Patrick Mahomes, the DNA of Andy Reid, the DNA of Travis Kelce … it’s hard to bet against these guys. If I was putting my chips on anybody, it’s the Kansas City Chiefs.”

Kansas City is once again among the top contenders

Although the Chiefs no longer rely exclusively on Mahomes’ arm the way they did in previous seasons, the evolution of their offense has made them a far more balanced team. They can now control the tempo of games with a powerful ground attack and, when the moment demands it, still turn to a quarterback capable of making the difference in critical situations.

Significant challenges remain on the schedule, but Week 11 offers an excellent opportunity as they host the Arizona Cardinals . Barring a major upset, Kansas City is well-positioned to improve to 8-2 and stay on the heels of the Bills in the race for home-field advantage throughout the playoffs.

articles.title: Chiefs reportedly losing faith in Harrison Butker as veteran kicker emerges as surprise option
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs have stood by Harrison Butker through years of clutch performances, but a troubling 2026 campaign may have forced Kansas City to explore an unexpected alternative.
articles.summary: The Chiefs have stood by Harrison Butker through years of clutch performances, but a troubling 2026 campaign may have forced Kansas City to explore an unexpected alternative.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs appear to still have a major dilemma on their hands and continue exploring options to strengthen one of the positions that has created the most uncertainty throughout the season.

After working out offensive lineman Fred Johnson on Tuesday, the team also evaluated another veteran with extensive NFL experience.

Despite recently adding former Baltimore Ravens kicker Justin Tucker to the practice squad, Kansas City does not appear fully comfortable relying solely on Harrison Butker , who is going through one of the most challenging stretches of his career.

The veteran kicker has converted just 12 of 19 field goal attempts this season and has also missed an extra point, numbers that are unusual for one of the league’s most reliable specialists over the past several years.

That uncertainty led the Chiefs to work out veteran kicker Matt Prater , a former player for the Detroit Lions and Denver Broncos , according to Mike Garafolo.

“The Chiefs worked out veteran K Matt Prater today,” Garafolo reported Tuesday afternoon.

Matt Prater emerges as another option for the Chiefs

At 42 years old , Prater owns one of the longest and most respected careers among NFL kickers. After going undrafted in the 2006 NFL Draft , the former UCF standout signed with the Detroit Lions, but was released before appearing in a regular-season game.

His breakthrough came with the Denver Broncos , where he remained until October 2014 and established himself as one of the NFL’s top kickers. He later returned to Detroit , playing for the Lions through the 2020 season .

After a brief stint with the Arizona Cardinals , Prater delivered a strong performance in 2025 with the Buffalo Bills , stepping in while Tyler Bass recovered from injury.

The veteran proved he could still perform at a high level, missing only two field-goal attempts during the season and finishing with a 90% field-goal accuracy rate, the second-best single-season mark of his career since 2015 .

Although his age was one of the reasons he remained a free agent during the offseason, his recent production suggests he can still deliver in high-pressure situations.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes injury news delivers brutal warning to the Chiefs’ biggest rivals
articles.standfirst: The rest of the NFL may have a major problem: Patrick Mahomes is finally getting back to 100%, and the Chiefs could be unleashing their most dangerous version yet.
articles.summary: The rest of the NFL may have a major problem: Patrick Mahomes is finally getting back to 100%, and the Chiefs could be unleashing their most dangerous version yet.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs a ppear to have found a valuable addition in Josh Downs, but the news that could truly change the NFL landscape has a much bigger name attached to it: Patrick Mahomes .

While Kansas City continues its strong start with a 7-2 record , a revelation from Ian Rapoport has caught the attention of the entire league: the superstar quarterback had not yet reached his best physical form and may only now be entering the stage where he fully regains his explosiveness and elite playmaking ability after a difficult recovery.

The possibility of Mahomes returning close to 100% represents a major threat to every contender, especially in an AFC where the Chiefs remain one of the most dangerous teams in football.

Patrick Mahomes was not at 100% yet

“Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes is just now getting close to 100%,” Rapoport reported.

“He’s coming back from an ACL and LCL injury. This is about the time when you hoped he would be Mahomes again. This is what we’re getting ready for with Mahomes — for him to be himself and take off,” Rapoport added.

The Chiefs are tied atop the AFC West with the Denver Broncos , but a fully healthy Mahomes could once again reshape the entire conference race.

Chiefs become dangerous again with Mahomes trending upward

The knee recovery was not Mahomes’ only concern. Before the matchup against the Atlanta Falcons , the quarterback admitted he had doubts about how his arm would respond after a difficult week of practice.

However, when it was time to compete, the three-time Super Bowl champion reminded everyone why he remains one of the greatest quarterbacks of the modern era.

Mahomes threw five touchdown passes, finished with 348 passing yards, and led Kansas City to a dominant 35-13 victory over Atlanta.

Before the game, Mahomes admitted he was unsure how his body would respond under the pressure of an NFL matchup .

“I didn’t feel like during the week of practice, I was driving the ball the way I wanted to. Just because of some of those deeper in-cut routes and the different balls down the field, you don’t know until you get out there and that adrenaline starts kicking a little bit. And obviously, it was good enough,” Mahomes said.

If Mahomes continues regaining his explosiveness and his trademark deep-ball ability, the Chiefs could once again become the biggest nightmare for their rivals during the final stretch of the season.

Kansas City will return to action Sunday when it hosts the Arizona Cardinals.

But the most memorable part of their gender reveal may be the few seconds after the blue confetti bursts from the cake: Brittany beams, Patrick kisses her, and their children look stunned. Bronze covers his ears, while Sterling and Golden watch from beside the cake and in Patrick’s arms.

Their first reactions are quiet and a little bewildered, a striking contrast with Brittany’s excitement. The moment doesn’t last: later in the video, the children join the celebration, even ending up sprawled on the floor. The big news lands differently on everyone, then the kids find their way into the fun.

The baby will be the couple’s fourth child and second son. Sterling will become the oldest of four, Bronze will have a little brother, and Golden, currently the youngest, will become a big sister.

The family has not shared the baby’s name, due date or how far along Brittany is, so there’s no reliable way to estimate when he will arrive.

articles.title: Taylor Swift leaves Travis Kelce alone to return to the stage at the CMA Awards after 13 years
articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift is leaving Travis Kelce behind for a historic night of her own as she returns to the CMA Awards stage after 13 years.
articles.summary: Taylor Swift is leaving Travis Kelce behind for a historic night of her own as she returns to the CMA Awards stage after 13 years.
articles.body:
Taylor Swift will return to the CMA Awards stage for the first time in 13 years , one of the most anticipated moments of the ceremony’s milestone 60th edition.

The Country Music Association and ABC confirmed that the superstar will perform on Wednesday, November 18 , at Bridgestone Arena in Nashville. It will be her first CMA Awards performance since 2013 and her first appearance at the show since 2016 , when she presented Garth Brooks with Entertainer of the Year .

Lainey Wilson returns as host for the third consecutive year.

Another historic nomination for Swift

In addition to performing, Swift is nominated for Single of the Year for “I Knew It, I Knew You,” her song from the Toy Story 5 soundtrack. The nod marks her 26th career CMA Awards nomination . She already has 12 wins, including Entertainer of the Year in 2009 and 2011.

Swift first attended the ceremony in 2006 and won her first CMA the following year (the Horizon Award). In 2009 she made history as the youngest artist ever to win Entertainer of the Year—a record that still stands.

A nostalgia-filled return

Her last CMA performance came in 2013, when she delivered an acoustic version of “Red” alongside Vince Gill and Alison Krauss . That same night she received the prestigious Pinnacle Award, given to artists whose impact has transformed country music and expanded its global reach. The honor was presented by Tim McGraw , Faith Hill , George Strait , Brad Paisley , Keith Urban , and Rascal Flatts —artists she had opened for early in her career.

Since then, Swift has become one of the biggest pop stars in the world. Her return to the CMAs represents an emotional reunion with the genre that launched her.

She will share the stage with performers including Miranda Lambert , Kacey Musgraves , Tim McGraw , Ella Langley , Cody Johnson , Zach Top , Tucker Wetmore , and The Red Clay Strays (among others) .

The 60th Annual CMA Awards air live from Nashville on Wednesday , November 18, from 8:00 to 11:00 p.m. ET on ABC and Disney+ . The show will be available on Hulu the following day. Additional presenters are expected to be announced in the coming hours.

Will Travis Kelce be there?

There is still no official confirmation that Travis Kelce will accompany her. His absence remains possible due to NFL commitments with the Kansas City Chiefs , as the team’s schedule could make a midweek trip to Nashville difficult.

articles.title: Andy Reid's new plan for the future will leave out one of the Chiefs' stars
articles.standfirst: Kenneth Walker III could skip the Sunday’s upcoming game against the Arizona Cardinals
articles.summary: Kenneth Walker III could skip the Sunday’s upcoming game against the Arizona Cardinals
articles.body:
Andy Reid appears ready to take a cautious approach with Kenneth Walker III , even if the Kansas City Chiefs running back is healthy enough to face the Arizona Cardinals this weekend as the priority is getting him fully recovered for the tougher stretch ahead, including the meeting with the Buffalo Bills . Walker sustained a groin injury during the practice week before Kansas City 's 35-13 victory over the Atlanta Falcons on November 15, and he was ruled out, leaving rookie Emmett Johnson to start and give the coaching staff a strong reason not to rush him back.

Barring an unexpected change, the plan is to keep Walker out against Arizona rather than risk aggravating the injury as groin injuries have a tendency to linger, meaning the extra recovery time would give him a better chance of returning for the Chiefs ' matchup with the Bills , when Kansas City will want its key options available. Walker 's injury has been described as minor, but the Chiefs have little need to force his return after seeing what Johnson can provide as the rookie excelled in Atlanta , showing he can handle a significant workload and giving the offense another dependable option in the backfield. Johnson finished the 35-13 win with 101 rushing yards on 22 carries, then added six catches for 70 yards and two touchdowns, with his 171 scrimmage yards were especially impressive considering he had entered the game with only 26 carries across the season so far.

Johnson gives Reid a reason to be patient

Reid revealed the Chiefs had tried to help Johnson reach 100 rushing yards late in the game, something they would not normally do, as the gesture underlined how much the rookie's performance meant to the team and how quickly he has earned the staff's trust. And running backs coach DeMarco Murray made a point of congratulating Johnson in the locker room, greeting the rookie with a handshake whilst Reid also praised him on Monday, highlighting his production and the way he has adapted to the offense since arriving in Kansas City . “My hat goes off to him — I mean, he had, what, 171 yards or whatever it was of total offense. That’s a lot of contribution to the group there,” Reid said, as the coach added that Johnson had shown the ability, attitude and intelligence to handle the opportunity. Meanwhile, Johnson , a fifth-round pick in the 2026 NFL Draft has also credited offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy for demanding attention to detail throughout his development. “I love being coached hard. I don't want anything handed to me,” Johnson said, describing the standards that have helped him prepare for a larger role as his performance gives the Chiefs confidence that it can manage the backfield without immediately relying on Walker . The side improved to 7-2 with the win, and keeping their running backs healthy could prove increasingly important as the schedule becomes more demanding as they aim to win the No. 1 seed in the AFC for the NFL Playoffs . Walker has been heavily utilized this season, making a careful recovery particularly sensible, and rather than risk losing him for longer by bringing him back too soon, Reid can give the groin injury time to settle while Johnson gets another opportunity against Arizona .

articles.title: Tyreek Hill and his “betrayal” of Patrick Mahomes: Is the wide receiver is heading to the Chiefs’ biggest rival?
articles.standfirst: The Buffalo Bills have emerged as contenders to sign the former Kansas City star, potentially setting up a reunion with Patrick Mahomes in the NFL Playoffs
articles.summary: The Buffalo Bills have emerged as contenders to sign the former Kansas City star, potentially setting up a reunion with Patrick Mahomes in the NFL Playoffs
articles.body:
Tyreek Hill is preparing for an NFL comeback, and the possibility of joining the Buffalo Bills has added an intriguing twist to his future as the former Kansas City Chiefs receiver is reportedly attracting interest from several teams, and is linking up with Josh Allen now a favored move? The prospect of Hill lining up against Patrick Mahomes in the NFL Playoffs has strengthened for the 32-year-old, with the Highmark Stadium -based side emerging as a prominent contender according to a Polymarket snapshot which gave the Bills a 44 percent chance of signing the free agent.

Placing them among the favorites, it is not confirmation of negotiations or an agreement, but it puts Buffalo firmly into the conversation as the 2019 Super Bowl champion, dubbed Cheetah for his fearsome acceleration and speed, works towards returning to the field. Such a move would carry considerable significance. Hill spent six seasons in Kansas City , where he became one of the NFL 's most dangerous offensive weapons and after being drafted in 2016, he developed a devastating connection with Mahomes , helping transform the Chiefs into a terrifying attack. The Chiefs eventually traded him to Miami in 2022 after the two sides failed to agree on a new deal, and he continued to thrive with the Dolphins , recording more than 1700 receiving yards in both 2022 and 2023, but his time in Florida ended after a serious knee injury in Week 4 of 2025. The 32-year-old dislocated his left knee and suffered multiple ligament tears, including an ACL injury as he underwent major surgery and managed only four appearances that season before Miami released him in February this year, leaving his NFL future dependent on a successful rehabilitation.

A comeback could put Hill on the opposite side of the Chiefs rivalry

Hill 's agent, Drew Rosenhaus , offered an encouraging update during an appearance on The Pat McAfee Show on November 10 as he said he expected his client to return during the season and indicated that teams would be approached once he received medical clearance, but that clearance has not yet arrived. And his next venue is still up in the air as Kansas City has an obvious emotional and football connection to Hill and the Chiefs have reportedly contacted Rosenhaus about a possible reunion, while Mahomes , Kelce and Chris Jones have all been described as supportive of bringing the receiver back. His previous success alongside Mahomes makes the prospect particularly appealing but Buffalo , however, would offer a very different storyline as the Bills are among the teams being linked with Hill , and the reported 44 percent Polymarket figure has placed them at the center of the speculation. That market estimate is not evidence of a deal, but a move to Buffalo would put Hill in direct competition with his former quarterback to land his signature whilst the Los Angeles Rams and San Francisco 49ers have also been mentioned as possible destinations. Ultimately, Hill 's next move will could spell a return to Kansas City to reunite him with Mahomes , whilst signing with Buffalo would create an entirely different storyline, as would the Rams and 49ers . Either way, where he signs could have massive Super Bowl repercussions around the NFL .

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes will keep trusting rookie Emmett Johnson while Kenneth Walker works his way back
articles.standfirst: Rookie Johnson finished his first start with 171 scrimmage yards and two touchdowns
articles.summary: Rookie Johnson finished his first start with 171 scrimmage yards and two touchdowns
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs appear prepared to keep stellar offseason acquisition Kenneth Walker III sidelined for Sunday’s Week 11 clash against the Arizona Cardinals , after he also sat out last weekend’s commanding 35-13 road victory over the Atlanta Falcons .

Sitting comfortably atop the AFC West at 7-2 and facing one of the NFL’s struggling clubs, head coach Andy Reid and the medical staff prefer getting Walker , who has already piled up 872 rushing yards and 1,044 all-purpose yards this year, back as close to 100 percent as possible before the most grueling stretch of their schedule begins.

Starting next week with a Thanksgiving Night road showdown against the Buffalo Bills , Kansas City embarks on a brutal five-game gauntlet featuring consecutive away trips to face the Los Angeles Rams and Cincinnati Bengals before returning to Arrowhead Stadium to host the New England Patriots and San Francisco 49ers .

Is Rookie Emmett Johnson Time While Kenneth Walker Recovers

Beyond facing a 3-7 Cardinals squad led by rookie quarterback Carson Beck , the Chiefs feel zero urgency to rush Walker back because rookie running back Emmett Johnson has proven more than capable of carrying the load.

Selected out of Nebraska in the fifth round (161st overall) of the 2026 NFL Draft , Johnson delivered a breakout performance in his first career NFL start against Atlanta, churning out 101 rushing yards on 22 carries alongside six receptions for 70 receiving yards and two touchdowns, totaling 171 yards from scrimmage .

Johnson’s versatility gives Reid and Patrick Mahomes complete peace of mind in the backfield. Not only can the 23-year-old handle lead-back duties again versus Arizona, but once Walker returns to full health, Kansas City will boast arguably the most explosive two-headed running tandem in football.

Having a dependable ground game allows Mahomes to operate with surgical rhythm from the pocket, much like last Sunday when he carved up the Falcons for five passing touchdowns, 348 passing yards, and a 135.5 passer rating .

With Walker and Johnson anchoring the run game alongside a loaded receiving corps featuring Travis Kelce, Rashee Rice, Josh Downs, and Xavier Worthy , Mahomes is commanding Kansas City’s deepest, most dangerous offensive arsenal since Tyreek Hill departed back in 2022.

articles.title: Caitlin Clark reveals to Travis Kelce the plan she has in the works with her sneakers to cheer on the Chiefs
articles.standfirst: The Indiana Fever star appeared on New Heights, Travis and Jason Kelce's podcast, where she talked about her new CC1s, recalled that she remains undefeated at the Kansas City games she has attended, and hinted at a special idea for a future Chiefs night.
articles.summary: The Indiana Fever star appeared on New Heights, Travis and Jason Kelce's podcast, where she talked about her new CC1s, recalled that she remains undefeated at the Kansas City games she has attended, and hinted at a special idea for a future Chiefs night.
articles.body:
Caitlin Clark once again drew attention off the court during her appearance on New Heights.

The basketball player spoke with Travis and Jason Kelce about the development of her Nike sneaker line, the expectations she has for its upcoming releases, and the care she puts into every product that bears her name.

Caitlin Clark, the Chiefs' lucky charm: she remains undefeated when she goes to the stadium

Clark also spoke about the good luck that seems to follow her every time she attends a Kansas City game. The player said that she still hasn't lost any of the Chiefs games she has attended as a spectator, a streak that did not go unnoticed by Travis Kelce.

That’s why Trav tells me I have a season ticket pass

Caitlin Clark's plan to cheer on the Chiefs with her sneakers

During the conversation, Clark showed off a pair of black sneakers and pitched the Kansas City tight end an idea for a future game night.

Trav, I know your guys are super excited about this. I said we were coming to a Chiefs playoff game and doing the blackout theme in the suite and all wearing these blackout CCs

The player's idea is to organize a completely black-themed setup in the suite, with everyone present wearing the same sneaker model .

Caitlin Clark is also preparing a Christmas release inspired by Kobe Bryant

Beyond the black model, the basketball player took advantage of her appearance on the podcast to showcase other new releases from her collection. Among them was a special edition of the Caitlin 1 that Nike is preparing for Christmas , with a design inspired by the famous Kobe Grinch , one of the most memorable models by Kobe Bryant.

Clark's high standards for her line were also one of the topics of conversation. The player explained that she is very careful with the products that bear her name and that her goal is to develop fabulous sneakers, both for their performance and their design.

That ambition is also reflected in the future of her collection. Nike is already working on the Caitlin 2 and has started talking about the Caitlin 3. MARCA has already published information about that project and the role Clark hopes to play as an inspiration for new generations, a connection that she herself linked to Kobe Bryant's legacy.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes gets lucky: He ties score with Brittany, while mom Randi and brother Jackson react to the big news
articles.standfirst: The Mahomes family has another reason to celebrate after an emotional gender reveal
articles.summary: The Mahomes family has another reason to celebrate after an emotional gender reveal
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes may be accustomed to winning on the football field, but the Kansas City Chiefs quarterback has celebrated a different kind of result after discovering his fourth child with wife Brittany Mahomes will be another boy.

The three-time Super Bowl champion had recently joked that he and son Bronze were outnumbered at home, with Brittany and daughters Sterling Skye and Golden Raye holding a three-to-two advantage.

That balance is now set to change after the couple revealed the gender of their unborn child in a family video shared on Instagram, just one week after announcing Brittany 's pregnancy.

Their three children joined them around a white cake decorated with pink and blue flowers, with the words “Oh baby” written across the top.

Patrick and Brittany dipped the rims of champagne glasses into the cake, revealing blue frosting inside. The discovery prompted an excited celebration, with blue and gold confetti filling the room as the couple embraced.

The quarterback later responded to Brittany 's announcement with three light blue heart emojis, while relatives and friends quickly joined the celebrations.

Randi and Jackson Mahomes react

Patrick's mother, Randi Mahomes , was among the first family members to express her happiness following the reveal.

“My heart,” she wrote beneath the Instagram video, capturing her excitement at the prospect of welcoming another grandson.

His younger brother, Jackson Mahomes , was similarly enthusiastic, commenting: “Ahhhh cant wait!!!”

The announcement also attracted congratulations from friends of the couple, including Laura Smith-Schuster , wife of former Chiefs receiver JuJu Smith-Schuster .

“CONGRATULATIONS YALL!!!” she wrote, while Jacquelyn Dahl , wife of former MLB outfielder David Dahl , added: “Perfection!!”

The celebration represents another milestone for Patrick and Brittany , whose relationship began when they were teenagers in Texas before they married in Hawaii in March 2022.

Their eldest daughter, Sterling , is five, while Bronze is three and Golden , the youngest member of the family, was born in January 2025.

Patrick Mahomes wanted another boy

The gender reveal followed comments from Mahomes during a recent Chiefs press conference, when he acknowledged his excitement about becoming a father for the fourth time.

“Obviously it's a blessing to have another baby on the way. I'm excited for it,” he told reporters. “I'm hoping that me and Bronze can even up the score.”

However, Mahomes made clear that his preference was secondary to the health of the newest addition to their family: “I'm just praying for a healthy baby at the end of the day.”

The quarterback also entertained the possibility of another Super Bowl victory coinciding with Brittany 's pregnancy, following suggestions that previous announcements had brought Kansas City good fortune.

“I'm hoping. I don't know if Brittany is,” Mahomes joked. “But I'm hoping if we can keep that going and get another Super Bowl win with a baby on the way, that'd be awesome for sure.”

Whether that championship coincidence continues remains to be seen, but Mahomes already knows his next family milestone will bring the result he wanted.

articles.title: Andy Reid sends subliminal shot at Cardinals while giving a Kenneth Walker injury update
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City Chiefs are fresh off of two straight wins and will now face a struggling Arizona Cardinals team before a short turnaround.
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs are fresh off of two straight wins and will now face a struggling Arizona Cardinals team before a short turnaround.
articles.body:
Even the Kansas City Chiefs themselves probably thought they were going to get more resistance in Week 10. The Atlanta Falcons have been struggling, but playing at home should have given them a boost; especially since the Chiefs were without their star running back, Kenneth Walker III .

The Chiefs offense didn’t miss a single beat without Walker, though. Rookie Emmett Johnson stepped right into his role, running for 101 yards and catching six passes for 70 yards and two touchdowns. Walker’s groin injury isn’t considered major by any means, but Johnson’s performance has some wondering if the Chiefs might hold out Walker for another week.

Andy Reid doesn’t want to do anything “stupid” by rushing back Kenneth Walker from groin injury

Head coach Andy Reid gave a vague injury update on Walker’s status on Wednesday, but while doing so gave a bit of a subtle shot at their upcoming opponents, the Arizona Cardinals . Basically, the Chiefs would probably prefer to sit Walker in a game that might not be competitive, since they play on Thanksgiving in a huge matchup against the Buffalo Bills .

Johnson playing so well against the Falcons makes it all the more likely that Walker will be held out for the Cardinals game. Perhaps Walker would rush back if Johnson didn’t look so capable, but the Chiefs offense was humming without the injured running back against Atlanta. And the Cardinals seem to be in even worse shape than the Falcons.

Reid obviously wasn’t trying to demean his next opponent, but the reality of the situation is that the Chiefs are 15.5 point home favorites against a team starting a rookie quarterback in Carson Beck , with a very limited receiving corps and a defense that can’t stop anyone.

articles.title: Andy Reid reveals Travis Kelce is battling more than one injury ahead of Chiefs' next game
articles.standfirst: One of their most experienced players is dealing with physical issues that have followed him throughout the season
articles.summary: One of their most experienced players is dealing with physical issues that have followed him throughout the season
articles.body:
Kansas City heads into Week 11 with a 7-2 record after securing a 35-13 victory over the Atlanta Falcons. The team will now return to Arrowhead Stadium, where it hopes to extend its winning streak against the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday.

Travis Kelce's latest setback raises concerns

Despite the team's strong performance, Kelce's situation has become something to watch . The tight end was already managing a right ankle injury dating back to Kansas City's Week 6 victory over the Los Angeles Chargers , and his latest appearance against Atlanta brought another difficult moment.

During the first quarter , Kelce caught a pass from Patrick Mahomes for a 23-yard gain, but Atlanta safety DeMarcco Hellams rolled onto his right leg as he was brought down. Kelce struggled to get back on his feet, eventually leaving the field to have his ankle examined and taped by the team's medical staff.

Andy Reid provides an update on Kelce's condition

The 37-year-old was able to return in the second quarter, although he played a limited role for the remainder of the afternoon. He finished the game with two receptions for 30 yards, but q uestions remained about his availability for the upcoming matchup.

Head coach Andy Reid addressed the situation, confirming that Kelce is dealing with a high ankle sprain . However, he offered some reassurance about the tight end's recovery, explaining that this is something the veteran has experienced before and that he generally responds well when the injury gets aggravated . Reid also revealed that Kelce was frustrated about having to leave the game because he wanted to continue playing.

Kelce has remained one of Mahomes' most reliable targets this season, leading Kansas City with 35 receptions for 512 receiving yards and two touchdowns through nine games. His production has been important to the Chiefs' offense, particularly as the team looks to maintain its position near the top of the AFC standings .

articles.title: The Chiefs don't even need Travis Kelce back to look unstoppable
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs may have just found their most dangerous version yet, and they’re doing it even without a fully healthy Travis Kelce.
articles.summary: The Chiefs may have just found their most dangerous version yet, and they’re doing it even without a fully healthy Travis Kelce.
articles.body:
K ansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce raised concerns after aggravating his ankle again, but the situation also delivered an encouraging message to the rest of the NFL : the Chiefs’ offense can still produce at a high level even when its top weapon is not at 100 percent.

Kansas City is currently in its best offensive stretch of the season after securing a second straight win and scoring 35 or more points in consecutive games. Everything pointed to a major role for Kelce against the Atlanta Falcons following a 23-yard reception in the first quarter—until he reinjured the same ankle that had already been bothering him on that very play.

The issue forced the veteran tight end to leave the field briefly and head to the sideline, though he later returned and finished the game. His involvement, however, was limited: just two catches for 30 yards.

Even so, Patrick Mahomes once again showed why he remains one of the league’s elite quarterbacks. The star passer orchestrated a dominant performance with 348 yards and five touchdowns , underscoring that Kansas City’s offense has more weapons than many expected.

On Wednesday , head coach Andy Reid offered a positive update on Kelce’s status while noting the player’s frustration after what was at least his second ankle scare of the season (the first came in Week 6 against the Los Angeles Chargers) .

“He’s had this before … [His ankle] gets tweaked, and he recovers fairly quickly from there,” Reid told reporters. “He was very mad, wanted to play.”

Kelce clarifies the play that caused the injury

Kelce also addressed the incident on the latest episode of his podcast New Heights . He said he does not believe Falcons safety DeMarcco Hellams acted with malicious intent on the tackle.

“I don’t know if that was the case,” Kelce said of Hellams’ tackle. “And on the flip side, if it was a quote-unquote intentional, you know, extra grab and turn of the ankle, it’s just part of it.”

The tight end admitted that the intense pain initially made him think Hellams had gone after the ankle deliberately, but after reviewing the play he changed his mind.

articles.body:
Country music’s biggest night once again belonged in large part to Taylor Swift . After a 10-year absence from the CMA Awards , the superstar made a highly anticipated return and commanded attention with a radiant look that lived up to the occasion.

Taylor Swift Returns to the CMA Awards and Dazzles Without Travis Kelce by Her Side

In her first appearance at the CMAs since 2016 , Swift arrived in a vibrant yellow strapless Oscar de la Renta gown featuring a structured bodice and dramatic high-low hem. She completed the look with gold Jimmy Choo sandals, coral-toned lips, and multicolored stone earrings that caught the light on the red carpet.

Notably, she attended solo. Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce did not join her, remaining focused on team preparations for Sunday’s important home matchup against the Arizona Cardinals as the NFL season heads into its final stretch.

While Swift became one of the evening’s main points of interest in Nashville, Kelce continued working with the Chiefs ahead of the weekend game.

Swift is nominated for Single of the Year for “I Knew It, I Knew You,” her original song from the Toy Story 5 soundtrack . She is also scheduled to perform during the ceremony— her first CMA Awards stage appearance in 13 years.

Her history with the Country Music Association Awards now spans two decades. She first attended in 2006 in a black mermaid gown with long opera gloves by Elvira . In 2007 she won the Horizon Award (now New Artist of the Year) , and in 2009 she became the youngest-ever Entertainer of the Year winner—a title she claimed again in 2011 .

At the 2013 ceremony she received the prestigious Pinnacle Award , presented by artists she had opened for early in her career: Tim McGraw, Faith Hill, George Strait, Brad Paisley, Keith Urban, and Rascal Flatts. That night she walked the carpet in a striking red Elie Saab Haute Couture gown (a nod to her Red album) before changing into a black Alberta Ferretti look to perform an intimate version of “Red” with Alison Krauss and Vince Gill.

Her most recent prior appearance came in 2016 , when she presented Entertainer of the Year to Garth Brooks while wearing a black beaded Julien Macdonald dress .

After a decade away, Taylor Swift once again lit up country music’s biggest night—this time without Travis Kelce at her side.

articles.title: Taylor Swift can’t stop laughing after CMA hosts take hilarious shot at Travis Kelce wedding
articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift was all smiles when the CMA Awards hosts joked about her Madison Square Garden wedding with Travis Kelce.
articles.summary: Taylor Swift was all smiles when the CMA Awards hosts joked about her Madison Square Garden wedding with Travis Kelce.
articles.body:
For the third year in a row, Lainey Wilson hosted the CMA Awards , and she kicked off Wednesday night’s ceremony (Nov. 18) with a special guest: Brad Paisley .

The two opened with a musical monologue full of wit, poking fun at everything from dating apps to data centers and, of course, one of the world’s most famous couples: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce .

Taylor Swift laughs off Travis Kelce wedding joke at CMA Awards

With Swift in the building for her first CMA Awards performance in 13 years, the hosts couldn’t resist a few good-natured jabs. Paisley referred to a “blonde singer” who married a “football player,” a clear nod to Swift and Kelce’s July wedding at Madison Square Garden in New York .

Wilson jumped in to thank Paisley for remembering her own wedding, but he played dumb.

“What arena did you get married in?” Paisley asked.

Wilson explained that she and her husband, former NFL quarterback Devlin “Duck” Hodges , were married in a cave. “That’s fine too,” Paisley deadpanned. Wilson then revealed how her husband sold her on the unusual venue: with a parody of Lynn Anderson’s “Rose Garden,” the 1970 classic that topped the Hot Country Songs chart.

Taylor Swift switches from the Chiefs' red to shine in yellow on the red carpet at the CMA Awards

“I beg your pardon / I never promised you a Madison Square Garden,” Wilson sang, drawing laughs from the crowd, Swift included.

Paisley, who attended Swift and Kelce’s wedding celebration, also took the chance to greet the pop star: “Hi, Taylor, remember me? I’m the guy who ate all the shrimp.”

Swift attended the 60th Annual CMA Awards at Nashville’s Bridgestone Arena on Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026. It was her first appearance at the ceremony in 10 years and her first time performing on the CMA stage in 13. The global superstar returned to country music’s biggest night with a remarkable legacy, having won 12 CMA Awards in her career, including two Entertainer of the Year trophies.

articles.title: Travis Kelce just missed one of Taylor Swift's best nights, but Brittany Mahomes didn't leave her alone
articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift returned to the CMA stage in style, but Travis Kelce was forced to watch from afar as Brittany Mahomes joined her.
articles.summary: Taylor Swift returned to the CMA stage in style, but Travis Kelce was forced to watch from afar as Brittany Mahomes joined her.
articles.body:
T aylor Swift made her return to the CMA Awards stage after 13 years away, a special number for the singer because it is her favorite, to perform “I Knew It, I Knew You” during the 60th annual ceremony held at the Bridgestone Arena in Nashville .

Unfortunately for Travis Kelce , the Kansas City Chiefs star once again missed an event where his wife was shining at her absolute best — not by choice, but because of his commitment to being fully prepared for Sunday’s matchup against the Arizona Cardinals .

Taylor Swift replaces Travis Kelce with Brittany Mahomes

The 14-time Grammy Award winner attended the Country Music Association Awards in Nashville, Tennessee, where she shared the night with her close friend Brittany Mahomes .

Swift, who married Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce in July , was spotted sitting alongside the wife of franchise quarterback Patrick Mahomes during host Lainey Wilson ’s opening monologue.

The superstar delivered a performance filled with nostalgia, references, and surprise appearances. The show began with Swift singing the opening lines of the Toy Story 5 hit while making her way through the backstage area, where she crossed paths with several country music stars.

Brad Paisley appeared showing off some of Swift’s many trophies, Brooks & Dunn took part in a gambling-themed scene, and host Lainey Wilson handed the singer a pair of sunglasses. The performance also featured cameos from Eric Church and Little Big Town .

The biggest moment arrived when Swift stepped onto a stage inspired by Toy Story, wearing a sparkling cowgirl outfit inspired by Jessie, the iconic character from the franchise. The production paid tribute to the movie for which Swift wrote the song that reached No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

During the performance, Swift walked past Keith Urban , who played the banjo, while Bill Anderson handed her a custom guitar featuring silver edges and a sky-blue design covered with glittery clouds.

To close the performance, Swift walked toward a tree behind the stage featuring the words “Jessie was here” carved into the trunk before sitting down to perform the final part of the song.

Before Wednesday’s ceremony, Swift had already collected nine CMA Awards throughout her career. Her first victory came in 2007 with the Horizon Award , which was later renamed New Artist of the Year . In 2008 , she made history by winning Entertainer of the Year , becoming the youngest artist ever to receive the honor.

At this year’s ceremony, “I Knew It, I Knew You” was nominated for Single of the Year, marking Swift’s 26th CMA nomination. However, the award went to Ella Langley for her hit song “Choosin’ Texas.”

The ceremony was hosted by Lainey Wilson, who led the event for the third consecutive year. Ella Langley topped the nominations with nine, fueled by the success of her Billboard Hot 100 record-setting hit, while Miranda Lambert followed with seven. Kacey Musgraves and Ben West rounded out the top nominees with five nominations each.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes ‘disguised’ her baby bump in a stunning silver dress to support her friend Taylor Swift
articles.standfirst: Just one day after revealing she and Patrick Mahomes are expecting another baby boy, the 31-year-old stepped out in Nashville to cheer on her close friend’s historic return to the CMA Awards
articles.summary: Just one day after revealing she and Patrick Mahomes are expecting another baby boy, the 31-year-old stepped out in Nashville to cheer on her close friend’s historic return to the CMA Awards
articles.body:
B rittany Mahomes brought unmistakable red carpet glamour to Nashville’s Bridgestone Arena on Wednesday, November 18, stepping out solo at the 60th annual Country Music Association Awards to support her longtime friend Taylor Swift .

Arriving just eight days after announcing she is pregnant with her fourth child, the 31-year-old opted for a shimmering silver halter gown that artfully concealed and flattered her early baby bump.

The form-fitting metallic design featured intricate jewel embellishments gathered and cinched right across her midsection, creating a textured, sparkling silhouette that subtly disguised her growing bump under the camera flashes.

Mahomes completed the ensemble with strappy black heels and wore her long blonde hair styled in loose, cascading waves over her shoulders.

Once inside the arena, Mahomes took a prime seat directly next to Swift, 36, who was celebrating a major milestone in country music. The 2026 ceremony marked Swift’s first appearance at the CMA Awards in a decade and her first time performing on the show’s stage in 13 years.

Nominated for Single of the Year for “I Knew It, I Knew You” from the Toy Story 5 soundtrack, her 26th career CMA nomination, Swift delivered a nostalgic, crowd-pleasing medley featuring “I Knew It, I Knew You” alongside her early country classic “Our Song”.

Throughout the broadcast, which was hosted by Lainey Wilson for the third consecutive year, cameras repeatedly captured Mahomes and Swift laughing together in the audience.

During the opening monologue, Wilson and surprise guest Brad Paisley playfully teased Swift about her Madison Square Garden wedding to Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce , prompting a viral belly laugh from Mahomes beside her.

Expanding the Mahomes roster and celebrating a close-knit Chiefs bond

Mahomes ’s stylish night out in Music City capped off an emotional, celebratory week for her and Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes .

On November 10, the high school sweethearts shared a joint Instagram post showing their three children, daughter Sterling, 5, son Bronze, 3, and daughter Golden, 21 months, resting their hands on Brittany’s stomach, captioned “Another blessing from God” and “& then there were 6”.

Speaking to reporters the following day, the three-time Super Bowl MVP expressed his enthusiasm about welcoming another addition to the household and shared his hope for another son.

“Obviously it’s a blessing to have another baby on the way. I’m excited for it,” Patrick said during a Nov. 11 press conference. “I’m hoping that me and Bronze can even up the score.”

His wish came true on November 17, the eve of the CMA Awards, when the couple posted an Instagram video of a family cake-cutting gender reveal. As their three older kids watched, Patrick and Brittany dipped champagne glasses into a white cake to uncover bright blue filling and frosting, confirming that a baby boy is on the way to balance the family at two boys and two girls.

As the Mahomes family prepares for baby number four, their bond with Swift, forged through Swift’s relationship with Kelce, remains stronger than ever.

Patrick has previously spoken warmly about the genuine connection the two couples have built off the field and the positive energy Swift has brought to football.

“Taylor being at all the games has been awesome,” he said at a press conference ahead of Super Bowl 2025. “It’s been awesome to showcase her bringing light to the sport that I love and getting little girls like my daughter interested in watching the game.”

“I feel like I’ve built a great friendship with her, and my wife and Taylor have built a friendship as well. So it’s just cool to see how football can bring people together from every aspect of life.”

From Arrowhead Stadium suites to the front row of Nashville’s biggest night in country music, Brittany Mahomes proved once again that she is always ready to show up in style for the people closest to her.

articles.title: Pat Mahomes Sr. explains why his son, Patrick Mahomes, doesn't get along well with Xavier Worthy
articles.standfirst: Head coach Andy Reid pointed to defensive coverage schemes after Worthy’s catchless outing in Atlanta
articles.summary: Head coach Andy Reid pointed to defensive coverage schemes after Worthy’s catchless outing in Atlanta
articles.body:
Even during one of Kansas City ’s most explosive offensive performances of the 2026 season, wide receiver Xavier Worthy found himself on the outside looking in.

In the Chiefs ’ 35-13 Week 10 victory over the Atlanta Falcons on November 15, a contest in which Patrick Mahomes threw for 348 yards and five touchdowns, Worthy logged 57 offensive snaps, the heaviest workload of any wideout on the roster.

Yet the third-year speedster drew only three targets and finished the afternoon without a single catch.

Following the game, Kansas City head coach Andy Reid defended Worthy’s quiet stat line, noting that Atlanta deliberately clouded his side of the field and rolled safety help over the top to neutralize his vertical speed. According to Reid, that defensive attention naturally funneled opportunities toward other skill players.

However, during a Wednesday appearance on The 65 Toss Power Talk Show, the quarterback’s father, Patrick Mahomes Sr ., offered a much more candid assessment of why his son has struggled to build a consistent on-field rhythm with Worthy.

In Mahomes Sr. ’s view, the issue comes down to winning against man-to-man coverage and avoiding unnecessary turnovers, something receivers like Tyquan Thornton (who re-signed with Kansas City on a two-year deal in March and recorded 219 yards and two scores before landing on injured reserve in October) and newly acquired slot receiver Josh Downs have excelled at demonstrating.

“I think it's a situation where Tyquan, Josh Downs , they so far have shown that they're able to beat man [coverage],” Mahomes Sr. said.

“Patrick loves man [coverage]. So if you can beat man, you're gonna get a nice diet of balls. I think Worthy, he's running his routes, and he's doing it, but there's not a lot of space in there, and it's more of a high-risk throw with guys that close. So, you gotta pick and choose your shots that you take with him.

“In order for us to win ball games, I think we have to protect the football. And Patrick's gonna protect the football at all costs.”

How the Josh Downs trade and Worthy’s career trajectory shape Kansas City’s offense

Recognizing the need for a reliable separator in the passing game, Kansas City general manager Brett Veach struck a deal ahead of the November 10 trade deadline to acquire Downs from the Indianapolis Colts in exchange for 2027 fourth-, fifth-, and seventh-round draft picks.

Mahomes Sr. believes that integrating a proven route-runner like Downs will ultimately relieve pressure on Worthy and create cleaner throwing windows across the entire formation.

“That's not to say that once you get a couple of guys like Josh Downs, who can beat man, is gonna open up a lot of stuff for other people too,” Mahomes Sr. added. “That's gonna be some of the benefits of him being able to do that, like he's done it all his career… I don't think he's [Downs] had a QB of the caliber of Patrick before.

“So, once Patrick starts throwing him the ball more and more, I think some of these other guys are gonna start coming open, and then maybe we'll see some of the things we need to see.”

For Worthy , the lack of consistent chemistry with Mahomes marks a frustrating plateau after arriving in the NFL with sky-high expectations.

Selected No. 28 overall in the 2024 NFL Draft after shattering John Ross’s Scouting Combine 40-yard dash record with a 4.21-second sprint, the former Texas Longhorns star enjoyed an encouraging rookie campaign, hauling in 59 passes for 638 yards and six touchdowns before erupting for a Super Bowl rookie-record 157 receiving yards in Super Bowl 59.

Since that breakout postseason showcase, however, Worthy’s production has steadily declined. Injuries limited him to 42 receptions, 532 yards, and a single touchdown during the 2025 campaign, and through 10 weeks of the 2026 season he has managed just 33 catches for 278 yards and one score, posting a PFN WR Impact rating of 69.3 that ranks 73rd among NFL wideouts.

With Downs now drawing defensive focus underneath, Kansas City will hope Worthy can soon rediscover the open-field separation that made him a first-round pick.

articles.title: Jason Kelce 'shocks' Travis Kelce by not wearing underwear: “My thighs are very capable of handling it”
articles.standfirst: During a candid furniture-inspired detour on the “New Heights” podcast, the retired Philadelphia Eagles star defended his commitment to going commando
articles.summary: During a candid furniture-inspired detour on the “New Heights” podcast, the retired Philadelphia Eagles star defended his commitment to going commando
articles.body:
Over the years, New Heights with Jason and Travis Kelce has built a massive audience not just for breaking down NFL strategy, but for the unfiltered, brotherly banter that regularly catches listeners off guard.

On the Wednesday, Nov. 18 episode of the hit podcast, 39-year-old retired Philadelphia Eagles center Jason Kelce once again left Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce and show producer Brandon Borders stunned after doubling down on a personal wardrobe choice: skipping underwear altogether.

The unexpected tangent started when Jason spotted a brand-new dresser sitting inside Borders’s office and playfully pressed him about which drawer was reserved for undergarments.

That remark quickly spiraled into the classic debate over boxers versus briefs. While Borders explained that he prefers the “support” offered by hybrid boxer-briefs, Jason proudly declared his allegiance to “neither.”

Borders looked visibly shocked by the confession, and Travis immediately questioned how his older brother avoids everyday discomfort without an extra layer of fabric.

articles.title: Video catches Taylor Swift revealing what she really calls Brittany Mahomes
articles.standfirst: The singer starred in a spontaneous moment in which she repeated the nickname she uses to address Patrick Mahomes' wife.
articles.summary: The singer starred in a spontaneous moment in which she repeated the nickname she uses to address Patrick Mahomes' wife.
articles.body:
T aylor Swift showed how she usually calls Brittany Mahomes in a video that began circulating among the singer’s followers and Kansas City Chiefs fans. During a brief exchange, the artist repeats "Bri, Bri, Bri", using the nickname she uses to address Patrick Mahomes’ wife.

The scene is another reflection of the relationship the two have built since 2023, when Swift began attending Chiefs games to accompany Travis Kelce. Since then, the singer and Brittany have shared suites, celebrations, and gatherings outside the stadiums, becoming two of the most recognizable faces in the team's circle.

Taylor Swift and Brittany Mahomes: a friendship that began at Kansas City games

The first public interaction took place during the 2023-24 NFL season. Swift attended a Chiefs game for the first time on September 24, 2023, when the team faced the Chicago Bears at Arrowhead Stadium . Brittany, married to quarterback Patrick Mahomes, was part of the team's usual circle and soon began spending time with the singer.

One of the moments that drew the most attention came on October 12 of that year, during the game against the Denver Broncos . The cameras caught the two of them hugging and celebrating a score together. The images spread quickly and showed that the relationship went beyond simply being in the same suite.

Their closeness also extended beyond American football. In November 2023, Brittany shared a photograph with Swift and other women linked to Chiefs players. They also crossed paths on nights out in New York and at gatherings with the singer’s circle of friends .

During the games, the two also starred in other moments that fueled fans' attention, including a choreographed greeting to celebrate their respective partners' plays. The connection between Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce, teammates in Kansas City, also made it easier for their families to spend time together.

The friendship continued throughout the playoffs and reached Super Bowl LVIII in February 2024, when the Chiefs defeated the San Francisco 49ers. Swift was there to support Kelce and shared the championship celebration with Brittany and the rest of the team's circle.

Since then, their meetings were not limited to NFL game days . The singer also invited Brittany to private gatherings and celebrations with her friends, while the two continued to cross paths at different sporting events. Now, the video in which Swift repeats "Bri" offers another small glimpse into a relationship that began in the stands of Arrowhead Stadium.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes gets troubling Chiefs update as Kenneth Walker III’s injury status remains uncertain
articles.standfirst: A major Chiefs concern is emerging before kickoff as Patrick Mahomes could lose a key piece of his offense against the Cardinals.
articles.summary: A major Chiefs concern is emerging before kickoff as Patrick Mahomes could lose a key piece of his offense against the Cardinals.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs ’ offense could take a major hit ahead of their upcoming matchup against the Arizona Cardinals , a setback that could significantly impact the team’s production moving forward.

Andy Reid ’s squad continues preparing for this weekend’s showdown against the Arizona Cardinals, but not all the news has been positive. After dominating the Atlanta Falcons on the road, the Chiefs remain focused on the recovery of running back Kenneth Walker III , who missed that game because of a groin injury.

Concerns over his availability grew after Thursday’s practice

“For the second straight day, Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker did not practice due to his groin injury,” ESPN NFL insider Adam Schefter reported on X, formerly Twitter.

Kansas City managed to cruise past Atlanta without Walker, as rookie running back Emmett Johnson stepped up with more than 100 rushing yards , while Patrick Mahomes threw for nearly 400 yards . The defense also delivered a dominant performance, forcing the Falcons into four consecutive three-and-outs to open the game.

Still, the Chiefs understand that getting Walker back is a priority. While Kansas City has proven it can win without him, having one of its top playmakers available will be crucial during the final stretch of the season and in the team’s pursuit of another Super Bowl run.

Before suffering the injury, Walker III was enjoying the best season of his career and had started entering the conversation as a potential Most Valuable Player (MVP) candidate. Although that momentum has slowed after his absence, the running back remains a key piece of Kansas City’s offensive identity.

The Chiefs vs. Cardinals matchup is scheduled for Sunday at 1:00 p.m. ET.
